raw: {"tool":"plan-draft","args":{"inbox_id":"gh-1280-a0675a50f5b3","authored":{"scope":["Verify the current GH-1248 outer-loop implementation and existing ATE assets before planning a smoke-first campaign on the Mac Studio.","Plan a bounded smoke in disposable full clones and expendable scratch repositories, followed by a long window only if the smoke and independent review gates pass.","Plan semantic replay, candidate disposition, cleanup evidence, and a final report without automatic repair or filing."],"acceptance":["The smoke is limited to 20 minutes of discovery and 10 minutes of replay and cleanup, with at most 200 mutations, 25 per batch, 30 seconds per command, and a corpus cap of 100.","The smoke demonstrates target coverage, useful oracles, fixture reset, process cleanup, and honest classification before the long window opens.","The exact development SHA, environment, target list, seeds, corpus, and versions are recorded; an independent foreground supervisor enforces hard-stop and cleanup checks.","Codex review is bound to exact artifact hashes for the frozen long-run contract and final dispositions; if review cannot run, the long window remains closed.","The report records exercised surfaces, classification denominators, replay evidence or an honest zero-defect result, and a stop/go decision."],"open_questions":["What are the remaining smoke tracks and long-run conditions beyond the truncated issue body?","What has changed in GH-1248 and the existing campaign machinery since the issue was written?"],"write_set":["utils/py/fuzz_engine.py","utils/py/adaptive_ate.py","utils/ate/scripts/run_variations.py","utils/py/domain_oracles.py","utils/py/gen4_campaign.py"]}},"reason":"This is the oldest eligible actionable request; its material supports a bounded campaign plan, while the truncated body leaves details to verify.","confidence":0.98}
